fields.name: reason
fields.description: Concrete, human-readable reason a reset/delete did not complete — surfaced so a reset:false response is not a bare 'Failed to delete'.

fields.name: failedPortraits
fields.description: Character names whose portrait could not be resolved/linked during scene generation — never silently swallowed.

fields.name: failedExtractions
fields.description: Raw LLM chunk-extraction JSON that failed to parse during extractChunked, one JSON-encoded {context,error,rawResponse,failedAt} blob per failure.
